Ryson's All Seeing Eye is a crystal ball located in Winterax Cave in Alterac Valley. It belonged to Syndicate Master Ryson but was stolen by the Winterax trolls. Druids may shapeshift, but players must generally be very careful when bringing it back to Ryson in the Veiled Cleft.

Safety First is a neutral quest in the quest chain. In this quest, players are sent by Razzeric the goblin pilot to Gadgetzan to discuss modifications to his seaforium booster with the engineer Shreev.

Sage Truthbearer was a paladin protecting King Terenas's urn alongside Uther Lightbringer and Ballador the Bright. He and his Champions of Truth were slain by Arthas in Andorhal. He would eventually make an appearance in World of Warcraft: Season of Discovery, known simply as Gregory, during a Paladin specific quest chain in Felwood however, it has been revealed that he had been returned as a Death Knight.

The Salamander is a draenei unit that helped kill the fel orcs when Illidan was closing the Portals on Outland to prevent Magtheridon's demons from getting through. They are trained at the Draenei Barracks. They are found in the Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne Human campaign.

s.]] Saldean's Farm is unique in Westfall in that it is the only farm that was never completely overrun by the Defias Brotherhood. Though Defias harvest golems roam the fields, Farmer Saldean and his wife Salma Saldean have stubbornly refused to leave. The farmhouse has been serving as a halfway house for years, and the couple does its best to keep their guests alive.
Saenorion is a night elf leatherworking vendor located in the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, he was caught in the chaos and could be saved.

Salamander Scale Pants are leather leg armor with intellect, stamina and fire resistance. They increase healing done by spells and restore mana every five seconds. These pants are definitely more competitive than Cenarion Leggings, and are regarded to be very slightly better than Stormrage Legguards (situationally).
Sadist's Collar drops from Gothik the Harvester in Naxxramas.
Safe Fall is a passive skill which allows rogues to fall from greater heights without taking as much damage as they normally would.

Sailing ships are a type of ships. When Princess Poobah was trapped on the Jaguero Isle, she saw large sailing ships in the distance.

.]] The term sailor generically refers to those who sail the seas of Azeroth and their practices range from benign to despicable. Humans are well known for their sailing prowess, but many races have proficiency on the waters of Azeroth. The basic sailor, sometimes called a crewman, performs all the basic duties aboard a ship that usually don't involve cooking food or maintaining machines aboard. The head cook on a ship is usually called the galley chief. The engineer maintains machines and mechanisms. The leaders of most sailors and the boats they serve on are called captains. The more skilled among them are usually called mates and navigators who serve their captain and act as the captain's

While in the Realm of Shadows one can find Shadowy Tormentors and Dark Riders of Acherus all around the area. During Phase Two, he is found, mounted on Fury, near the stage Prince Valanar is standing on while giving a speech to the death knights. His Dark Riders, now friendly, are found patrolling around. The Sack of Spectral Spiders drops from Arachnis, a rare spider that spawns in Lunarfall and Frostwall during Hallow's End, in garrisons that have purchased and used the Creepy Crawlers. Note that the condition applies to the garrison, and not to the player, so realm hopping using Group Finder will work to get to a garrison that has the spider. Arachnis can only be looted once daily, but respawns every few minutes. If Arachnis does not drop the toy, do not loot it, and wait for the next respawn.

Sagehold is a settlement in Stormsong Valley, nestled in the Tidebreak Foothills and below Stormwatch Peak. The Tidesages study here. It is overrun with k'thir and n'raqi, led by Wavespeaker Reid. The Rod of Tides is kept here. After the death of the Wavespeaker, the town is under the control of the Kul Tirans and the Alliance under the leadership of Captain Malia and Commander Augustine. Sagehold was attacked by the Horde shortly afterwards, who intended to leave it for Lord Stormsong's tidesages to reclaim.

__NOTOC__ The Sacred Sands is a partially sand-covered area that extends west from the central plaza of Skycallers' Spire in northern Vol'dun. It appears to primarily be a haunt for the Faithless' scrollkeepers, and is also where the Faithless hoard several ancient artifacts of Sethraliss. Tales of de Loa: Sethraliss is lying next to an altar in the northernmost corner of the Sacred Sands, guarded by a scrollkeeper and spireguard.
The Sailing Wolves are a bandit group located in Tiragarde Sound. Wolf's Den was their outpost until it was taken by the Horde.
__NOTOC__ Sacrificed Vilebranches are deceased forest trolls located at Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands.

Sal Atwater, also known as Old Atwater, is a human located at Atwater Stead in Stormsong Valley. After the re-emergence of the Dragon Isles, Sal and Dorian can be found in Iskaara in the Azure Span. He is eating a soup.
Sail Canvases are looted from Canvas Bolts and Crates of Canvas in Tiragarde Sound.
